I arrived early to the appointment, but the staff appeared to be preparing to close, despite the clinic not due to shut for another 30 minutes. The lights were off and cleaning staff were already present.

When I explained that I had an appointment, the staff seemed confused and told me there were no appointments left for the day. I was questioned in a rather patronising manner about whether I was in the correct place or had the right day, but no one asked for my name or referral details, which surely would have been the most basic step in checking their system and clarifying the situation. I was ultimately turned away without any attempt to investigate further.

I contacted my GP the next morning and they confirmed that the appointment had been correctly booked. I could give 0 stars, I would.

Their incompetence and medical negligence is just unbelievable. Every time I raise a health concern they are just absolutely not interested.

I went to seek help with heavy periods. DR Saraf just looked at me and said "what do you want me to do about it?" in the most condescending way possible. Her solution then was to put me on a mini pill. Without once checking my blood pressure before prescribing it or at any point during the 10 months I was on it. Result? I now have to take blood pressure medication for the rest of my life, it's affected my vision and I will need to see a cardiologist once a year for a foreseeable future.

Are these meds being reviewed to make sure they are working? Of course not!

I also have iron deficiency, due to the heavy periods. Was promised regular blood tests to make sure the levels stay in range.
Upon the last request to have them checked I've just had the answer of "they were fine 5 months ago so no need to check" when I had clearly stated I'm getting the same symptoms as the time before when they were extremely low!

Communication? Well, now you submit an online form to get an appointment. So far I've submitted 3. 2 got completely no reply. And the 3rd one featured a generic link with no option to respond or raise any further concerns.

I could go on about the lack of care and unprofessional attitude, but I genuinely don't believe they will change anything.
